title: Settings config check: every redactor PostToolUse entry has timeout and onFailure
reason_not_testable: The FIXTURE kinds in test-spec.md (post, pre, pre_exec, e2e) cannot express a check of settings JSON structure; no runner kind inspects hooks.PostToolUse entries. Covered only by a separate config lint on a copy of the settings file (not defined in the spec) and by manual review of settings against this checklist; the catalog itself says it does not prove timing.
